source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 471 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 471 was established by Ordinance No. 23113, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 14, 1997. Ordinance No. 23113 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 471 is established on property generally located between Walnut Street and Shadow Way, west of the G.C. & S.F. Railroad. The size of PD 471 is approximately 11.9685 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a multifamily use, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 471A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other uses, the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding the submission of or amendments to conceptual, development, site analysis, or landscape plans do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Agricultural uses.

-- Crop production.

(b) Commercial and business service uses.

-- None permitted.

(c) Industrial uses.

-- None permitted.

(d) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Adult day care facility. [SUP] -- Cemetery or mausoleum. [SUP] -- Child-care facility. [SUP] -- Church. -- College, university, or seminary. [SUP] -- Community service center. [SUP] -- Convalescent and nursing homes, hospice care, and related institutions. [RAR] -- Convent or monastery. -- Foster home. [SUP] -- Hospital. [SUP] -- Library, art gallery, or museum. [SUP] -- Public or private school. [SUP]

(e) Lodging uses.

-- None permitted.

(f) Miscellaneous uses.

-- Temporary construction or sales office.

(g) Office uses.

-- None permitted.

(h) Recreation uses.

-- Country club with private membership. [RAR] -- Private recreation center, club, or area. [SUP] -- Public park, playground, or golf course.

(i) Residential uses.

-- Duplex. -- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [SUP required if spacing component in Section 51A-4.209(3.1) is not met.] -- Multifamily. -- Retirement housing. -- Single family.

(j) Retail and personal service uses.

-- None permitted.

(k) Transportation uses.

-- Transit passenger shelter.

(l) Utility and public service uses.

-- Electrical substation. [SUP] -- Local utilities. -- Police or fire station. [SUP] -- Radio, television, or microwave tower. [SUP] -- Utility or government installation other than listed. [SUP]

(m) Wholesale, distribution, and storage uses.

-- Recycling drop-off container. [SUP required if the requirements of Subparagraph (E) of Section 51A-4.213(11.2) are not satisfied.] (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front, side, and rear yard.

(1) For multifamily uses, minimum front, side, and rear yard setbacks are as shown on the development plan.

(2) For all other uses, Subparagraphs 51A-4.116(a)(4)(A) and (B) apply.

(b) Density.

(1) Maximum dwelling unit density is 308 units.

(2) No application for a building permit for new construction for a multifamily use may be accepted unless the density requirements for a multifamily use contained in Section 51A- 4.116(a)(4)(C)(ii) are met.

(c) Height. Except as provided in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2), maximum structure height is 24 feet.

(d) Lot coverage.

(1) Multifamily uses. For multifamily uses, maximum lot coverage is as shown on the development plan.

(2) All other uses.

(A) Maximum lot coverage is:

(i) 60 percent for residential structures; and

(ii) 25 percent for nonresidential structures.

(B) Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(e) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(f) Stories. Maximum number of stories is two. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Off-street parking and loading for a multifamily use must be provided as shown on the development plan. Consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking requirements for all other uses. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A- 4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.110. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress for multifamily uses must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Security Improvements For Multifamily Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.111. SECURITY IMPROVEMENTS FOR MULTIFAMILY USES.

(a) A minimum six-foot-high security fence must be maintained as shown on the development plan.

(2) Security gates must be provided as shown on the development plan. Except for maintenance purposes, all security gates must remain closed at all times when not being used for vehicular ingress and egress. Security gates located on Walnut Street must operate and open independently of each other. The security gate on Shadow Way may only be used for emergencies. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping for multifamily uses must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(b) Landscaping for all other uses must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(c) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.114. LIGHTING.

All outdoor lighting must be operational, maintained in accordance with the Dallas Development Code, and be directed away from adjoining properties. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.116. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-471.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 471 is located on Zoning Map No. D-9. (Ord. Nos. 23113; 26042)
